name: @tieout/indexer
description: Ponder indexer (Batch 2) — indexes the pinned wstETH Transfer / stETH TokenRebased slice and accumulates the shared RawLog idempotently; the whole-range read-back into derive is deferred (see README).

scripts.dev: echo 'Refusing to run: use `ponder start`, never `ponder dev` — dev drops and recreates tables and disables crash recovery, breaking the NFR-0 determinism harness (see README).' && exit 1
